ns2:section.sectionText: This section is for LEEP students. Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@uiuc.edu); Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veteransø grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC, MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC, or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
